about.title: About Exchange Rate Calculator - Multi-Currency Conversion Tool
about.description: The Exchange Rate Calculator is a comprehensive multi-currency conversion tool designed to help you convert between different world currencies using real-time exchange rates. This calculator supports major currencies including USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, and many others, providing accurate conversions for international business, travel, investments, and personal finance planning. Whether you're comparing currency values or planning international transactions, this tool delivers precise exchange rate calculations.

faq.q: How often are exchange rates updated?
faq.a: Exchange rates are updated in real-time during market hours (Monday-Friday). Rates may be delayed by 15-20 minutes depending on the data source. Weekend rates typically reflect Friday's closing prices.

faq.q: Why do exchange rates differ between sources?
faq.a: Different providers use various data sources and may include different spreads. Interbank rates are the most accurate, while retail rates include margins for banks and exchange services. Our calculator uses mid-market rates for reference.

Exchange rates are affected by economic indicators, central bank policies, inflation, political stability, trade balances, market sentiment, and global events. Major economic announcements can cause significant rate movements.

faq.q: How can I get better exchange rates?
faq.a: For better rates, compare multiple providers, avoid airport exchanges, use online services, consider timing around major economic events, and for large amounts, negotiate with banks or use specialized foreign exchange services.
